title: fix: whisper returns srt/vtt again; gpt-transcribe accepts text
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Fixed `whisper` and `whisper-1` requests with `response_format=srt` or `vtt`: OVH is now asked for both word and segment timestamps, so subtitle cues use measured segments instead of returning 400. OVH `verbose_json` also includes those segments instead of a placeholder; a provider response with text but no segments returns 502 rather than an empty 200. The DeepInfra fallback is unchanged. `openai/gpt-transcribe` now accepts `response_format=text` and returns a plain transcript. Azure is still asked for JSON internally because that response includes the billed `usage.seconds`. Route, formatter, and Azure tests cover the changes.
